# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 23 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 23:6 — mother of all those who take refuge

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "mother of all those who take refuge in the Lord God Most High" | Literal mētēr pantōn tōn kataphygontōn |
| LOGOS | "mother of all who take refuge in the Lord God Most High" | Drops 'those' |
| PNEUMA | "mother of all who take refuge in the Lord God Most High" | Same as LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS/PNEUMA agree. 'All who take refuge' is more natural than 'all those who.' Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.
